beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part three of the Musinique mark. Surface moves: color interpolation, a kinetic tile grid, glitch slices that snap clean, and a five-layer trail echo. The mark holds still-ish; the surface does the talking.
Your turn. Paste this: glitch my logo into seven horizontal slices for half a second, then snap it perfectly clean — and make the clean snap land on a beat.
Musinique, in motion. Part three. Liam, in for Bear.
